articles.title: Global market: Mainland China stocks slip as metal shares drop, investors await Jackson Hole cues

Unitree’s sharp post-IPO decline raised valuation concerns, though Morgan Stanley expects potential catalysts from September.

articles.title: MSE: Building the capital markets of a Viksit Bharat
articles.description: India's capital market is on the brink of a transformative shift as more investors engage actively. The Metropolitan Stock Exchange (MSE) is dedicated to cultivating a resilient financial framework, improving accessibility, and mitigating costs for emerging investors throughout the nation. With a versatile platform powered by advanced technology, this initiative aspires to broaden wealth generation opportunities and contribute to the country’s overall prosperity.

articles.title: NU Vista receives ₹15.41 crore Show Cause Notice for input tax credit irregularities
articles.description: Cement firm NU Vista received a ₹15.41 crore notice alleging input tax credit irregularities. The notice covers four fiscal years from 2020-21 to 2023-24. It proposes denying input tax credit for civil construction and canteen expenses. The company also faces proposed denial of output tax credit reduction from sales returns. NU Vista claims sufficient evidence and expects no major financial impact.

articles.title: Global Market: Porsche stock falls as MHP sale, weak revenue keep investors on edge

The deal supports digital transformation, but weaker quarterly revenue, China competition, tariffs, EV costs and Volkswagen restructuring concerns continue to weigh on investor sentiment and Porsche’s turnaround prospects.

articles.title: Investors’ equity rush helps SIP assets triple in five years
articles.description: Mutual fund SIP investments have seen significant growth over five years. The number of unique mutual fund investors increased substantially during this period. SIP assets under management more than tripled, reaching ₹14.83 lakh crore. Equity funds continue to dominate SIP investments, holding an 87% share. Other categories like hybrid and passive funds also experienced notable increases.
